Transcend ESD310 512GB High-Speed Portable External SSD


Experience ultimate portability combined with blazing-fast data transfer speeds with the Transcend ESD310 Portable External SSD. Boasting a generous 512GB capacity in a remarkably compact, flash-drive-sized form factor, this mini solid-state drive delivers elite performance with read speeds up to 1000 MB/s and write speeds up to 900 MB/s. Whether you are backing up massive 4K videos, transferring heavy gaming files, or carrying critical work documents on the go, it ensures your data moves in the blink of an eye.


The standout feature of the Transcend ESD310 is its versatile dual-connector design, featuring both USB Type-A and Type-C connectors on opposite ends. This eliminates the need for annoying cables or adapters, allowing you to seamlessly share files across modern laptops, desktop PCs, tablets, gaming consoles, and smartphones. Wrapped in a sleek, lightweight, yet durable aluminum casing for optimized heat dissipation and protection, this heavy-duty portable SSD is the perfect high-speed storage companion for tech professionals, creators, and everyday users alike.


Transcend ESD310 512GB Portable External SSD

Storage & Performance

Capacity512GB
InterfaceUSB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps)
Read SpeedUp to 1000 MB/s
Write SpeedUp to 900 MB/s
NAND Type3D NAND Flash
CacheSLC Cache technology
Backward CompatibleUSB 2.0 and USB 3.0

Connectors

TypeDual connector — USB Type-A and USB Type-C, built-in (no cable needed)
CapsRemovable connector caps

Build & Design

Casing MaterialAluminum
Dimensions2.81 × 0.79 × 0.31 inches (~71.4 × 20 × 7.9 mm)
Weight~0.02 lb (~9g)
DurabilityShock and vibration resistant
ReliabilityBuilt-in ECC functionality for data stability
ColorsBlack, Silver, Pink

Compatibility

OS SupportWindows, macOS, iOS, Android
File SystemexFAT (default) — reformat to FAT32 if required by certain mobile devices
Mobile DevicesRequire USB OTG support

Software & Security

Companion AppTranscend Elite software
SecurityOne-Time Password (OTP) protection via email recovery

Warranty

Warranty Period1-year limited warranty
Quality TestingTested for vibration, temperature, humidity, speed, and functionality

Bottom line: A tiny, pocketable SSD with genuinely fast 10Gbps speeds, dual built-in connectors (no cable hassle), aluminum durability, and a 5-year warranty — a solid choice for everyday file transfers and backups, especially for mixed-device users (phone + laptop).
